body.insert: What is the Importance of Cell Group?

Acts 5:42 (NLT)
And every day, in the Temple and from house to house, they continued to teach and preach this message: “Jesus is the Messiah.”

Cell groups are a small groups of people who meet once a week with the goal of developing the growth of the members centered on the Word of God.

Cell groups are small centres for studying the Bible in a simple and practical way, where those who attend are built up, including those who are won for Christ week after week. It originated from the early Church whose congregations grew through meeting in homes.

1. It brings the presence of God into a homeThe goal is to illuminate the whole neighbourhood with the light of the Gospel.

2 Samuel 6:11 (NLT)
The Ark of the LORD remained there in Obed-edom’s house for three months, and the LORD blessed Obed-edom and his entire household. 

2. The success of the Church is in the Cell groupsCell groups facilitate the training and equipping of the saints, who then spread the message of Jesus Christ to all.

3. Cell groups make mentoring possibleCell groups allow us to do what Jesus did.

When the Church are all committed and doing the Cell group, the results are more effective, and everyone at the Church will always feel cared for.

4. It strengthens the Church.

Acts 2:46-47 (NKJV)
46 So continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, they ate their food with gladness and simplicity of heart, 47 praising God and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily those who were being saved.

How to Multiply Your Cell group?

1. PREPARATION 
A key to determining the success of the cell group is the PREPARATION OF EACH LEADER in the different areas of their lives.

1 Corinthians 14:40 (NKJV)
Let all things be done decently and in order.

Colossians 3:17 (NKJV)
And whatever you do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.

2. PRAYER AND FASTING
Daniel 10:12 (NKJV)
Then he said to me, “Do not fear, Daniel, for from the first day that you set your heart to understand, and to humble yourself before your God, your words were heard; and I have come because of your words.

God is not deaf and he hears and answers our prayers from the very first day that we prayed. Interference in our prayers often comes from the enemy. That's why we should not overlook the weapon of strategic prayer and fasting.

3. FAITH
Romans 10:17 (NKJV) 
So then faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

Faith allows us to see that what we thought was impossible is possible
Diligently studying God’s Word allows His voice to reach our hearts

A Cell group leader needs to allow their mind and heart to become a permanent storehouse of the Word of God so that faith can be continually activated in his or her life
Visualise the miracle What does “visualizing the miracle,” mean? It means painting a clear, detailed picture in our minds of what we want God to do for us based on His Word. Confess the miracle Faith speaks God’s Word over situations. Faith speaks words of life, not negative, harsh or bitter words

Nothing is impossible for those who have placed all their trust in God

4. PERSEVERANCE
Galatians 6:9 (NKJV)
and let us not grow weary while doing good, for in due season we shall reap if we do not lose heart.

Perseverance is the foundation for Cell group multiplication. Every cell group should contribute to the growth of the Church. We must persevere in studying the Word, in fellowship, in sharing and in prayer

Acts 2:42 (NKJV)
And they continued steadfastly in the apostles’ [a]doctrine and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and in prayers.

Winners never quit. Quitters never win
-John Maxwell

A leader of faith tries again and sets aside any failure because their eyes are fixed on Jesus.

Hebrews 12:2 (NKJV)
looking unto Jesus, the author and finisher of our faith, who for the joy that was set before Him endured the cross, despising the shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

God is just looking for us to do our part, by doing what is possible and He will do His part, the impossible.

5. WORK WITH YOUR CELL GROUP MEMBERSOnce Nehemiah assessed the situation, he did not start working on repairing the wall. He knew the task was too great for him to complete on his own.  He needed to motivate the people to get involved.  

Nehemiah 2:17-18 (NKJV) 
17 Then I said to them, “You see the distress that we are in, how Jerusalem lies waste, and its gates are burned with fire. Come and let us build the wall of Jerusalem, that we may no longer be a reproach.”

18 And I told them of the hand of my God which had been good upon me, and of the king’s words that he had spoken to me. So, they said, “Let us rise up and build.” Then they set their hands to this good work.

The more people get involved, the more we can accomplish for the Kingdom of God
- Build a courageous team.
- A courageous leader will form courageous disciples.  But a cowardly leader will form cowardly disciples.
- God’s strategy to form His disciples into a courageous army has not changed.  He will always test us with small things first.  He will not hand over great responsibilities until we are ready for them.  

Every cell group member is capable of doing great things for God, but they must be formed by leaders who are willing to train them

WHAT IS THE IMPORTANCE OF THE CELL GROUP?
1. It is brings the presence of God into a home.
2. The success of the Church is in the Cell groups.
3. Cell groups make mentoring possible.
4. It strengthens the Church.

How to Multiply Your Cell group?
1. PREPARATION
2. PRAYER AND FASTING
3. FAITH
4. PERSEVERANCE
5. WORK WITH YOUR CELL GROUP MEMBERS
